title: Someone Walking Near
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The king built up a statue tall
And told the land to bow,
But three good friends stood straight and still
And kept their gentle vow.

[Chorus]
I am not alone, not alone,
Someone is walking near;
Through every hot and hard, hard place,
Heavenly Father's here.

[Verse 2]
"Our Father's able," said the three,
"To keep us from the flame;
And even if He does not, still
We'll stand true all the same."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
They went into the roaring heat,
The fire burning bright;
The king looked in and counted four
All walking in the light!

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Not one small hair was even burned,
Not one, not even one!
So I'll stand brave, for He is near,
In shadow and in sun.

[Chorus]
mood: Standing music. A small string quartet plays a firm, even step under the voice, like three friends planting their feet and not moving. The cello holds a low steady note while the violins climb a little higher each verse, and by the last chorus the step has become a bright, unhurried walk side by side.
